## Problem or need
Who would benefit and what is difficult today?

## Proposed behavior
Describe the improvement and a concrete example.

## Alternatives
What other approach did you consider?

## Acceptance checks
Describe how to verify the improvement without using real student information or employer data.

## Scope
Identify dependencies, accessibility needs and any limitations.
